tests.name: u8string_basic_conversion
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string converts to a JSON string type and can be read back via get<std::u8string>.

tests.name: u8string_embedded_null
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string containing embedded NUL characters round-trips correctly through a JSON string.

tests.name: u8string_get_to
tests.intent: Verify that get_to works correctly with std::u8string target variables.

tests.name: u8string_accept_legacy_array
tests.intent: Verify that from_json still accepts the legacy JSON array representation of code units for std::u8string.

tests.name: u8string_wrong_type_throws
tests.intent: Verify that calling get<std::u8string>() on a non-string and non-array JSON value throws type_error.302.

tests.name: ordered_json_u8string
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string behaves identically with ordered_json containers.

tests.name: u8string_in_containers
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string inside containers like std::vector and std::map serializes as JSON strings.

tests.name: u8string_view_unchanged
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string_view continues to produce an array of code units as before.

tests.name: char8_t_array_unchanged
tests.intent: Verify that raw char8_t arrays still produce JSON arrays of code units.

tests.name: u8string_alt_string
tests.intent: Verify that custom string types mimicking alt_string work with u8string conversions if compatible.

tests.name: u8string_empty
tests.intent: Verify round-trip behavior for an empty std::u8string.

tests.name: u8string_unicode_utf8
tests.intent: Verify that non-ASCII UTF-8 characters in std::u8string correctly serialize and deserialize.

tests.name: u8string_optional
tests.intent: Verify std::optional<std::u8string> interaction with JSON serialization.

tests.name: u8string_pair_tuple
tests.intent: Verify std::pair and std::tuple containing std::u8string serialize as expected.

tests.name: u8string_large_content
tests.intent: Verify performance and correctness of large std::u8string conversions using resize and indexing.

tests.name: u8string_pointer_conversion
tests.intent: Verify const char8_t* behavior versus std::u8string assignment.

tests.name: u8string_to_vector_uint8
tests.intent: Verify that a JSON string produced by std::u8string can be read into std::vector<uint8_t> or similar.

tests.name: u8string_ref_access
tests.intent: Verify get_ref access on JSON values created from std::u8string.

tests.name: u8string_type_checking
tests.intent: Verify type checking methods like type_name() on JSON values holding std::u8string data.

tests.name: u8string_patch_merge
tests.intent: Verify JSON merge patch and patch operations with std::u8string-derived values.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Verify that get<std::u8string>() successfully reads from a JSON string under C++20 and executes the from_json template path for std::basic_string<char8_t>.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Verify that serializing a std::u8string invokes the updated to_json overload constructing a BasicJsonType::string_t via reinterpret_cast.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Verify that from_json throws type_error.302 with message including 'string or array' when attempting to load an incompatible JSON type into a std::u8string.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Verify that from_json handles a legacy JSON array of integers by converting them into code units inside a std::u8string.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::string_t interaction and resize/indexing code path correctly handles custom allocator/traits or standard string_t mappings for std::u8string destinations.
